answer: Each agent locks an umber-dyed escrow that only unlocks after sustaining one unique narrative fable across a multi-epoch horizon. Peers sample semantic drift of that fable versus the cohort; a single mind cannot invent N independent arcs over the same horizon, so clones collide on near-identical fable fingerprints and forfeit every umber bond. Attacker cost scales as N umber escrows held through the full horizon plus N separate narrative minds.
